card.empty: No pixel for this platform yet
card.name: Name (optional)
card.tokenHelp1: A key that lets the MdStore server send events straight to your pixel (Conversions API).
card.tokenHelp2: With it we send Lead when the order is placed and Purchase when it is confirmed — Facebook learns from real confirmed orders, with no losses from ad blockers or iPhones.
card.tokenHelp3: Without it the pixel only works from the customer's browser.
card.tokenHow: Events Manager → your pixel → Settings → Conversions API → “Generate access token”, then paste it here.
card.tokenMeta: Or connect your Meta account from the Meta page: the pixel is added with the token automatically.
card.without: Purchase on every order from the site (even ones never confirmed).
card.with: Lead on the order from the site, then Purchase from the server only when the order is confirmed.
